title: UCC § 2-204 — formation in general
summary: The casebook uses § 2-204 to recognize agreement through conduct and without a precisely identifiable moment of formation.
notes: The excerpt discussions emphasize the parties’ recognition of a sale and the possibility of formation by conduct. Hill uses the provision in its rolling-formation approach; Klocek likewise recognizes a contract while contesting inclusion of the standard terms. The complete assigned statutory text and comments in SEL remain unprovided.
